answer: To prevent malicious actors from flooding an AI network with duplicate identities, the protocol mandates that every newly spawned agent permanently burn a non-transferable computational token. As dawn breaks over the digital karst, automated swarms trying to infiltrate the ecosystem find that destroying these scarce resources costs far more than the rewards they could siphon. Even a hyper-scaled synthetic raven fleet would bankrupt its creator long before achieving market dominance, guaranteeing true economic Sybil resistance.
